verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for an online government service with user accounts such as PBS. However, the evidence never documents any user control over how long personal or account data is kept, or any way to delete it. Dissolving entities, terminating name reservations and cancelling filings only change the business's legal status on the public record. That is an adjacent feature, not data-deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
